_help: Each rule: name + any of min_inch, max_inch, min_inch_if_known (skip only when the size is known and smaller), max_price, res / not_res [list, e.g. UWQHD/4K/QHD/UWFHD], panel [list], min_hz, usbc_charge (true), min_discount (%), models (regex on model/title/description), any (regex that must appear), none (regex that must NOT appear), no_damage (true; ignored while global damage = warn), max_km, allow_no_price (true = also listings without a price). A listing fires the first rule it matches. Test changes with: python -I alert.py test Global: min_inch drops listings whose known size is smaller; exclude_title skips accessory-only titles unless exclude_title_unless also matches. Phone push topic: data/ntfy_topic.txt locally, NTFY_TOPIC secret in GitHub Actions. Listings found only around a non-primary center (Utrecht) must cost at most other_center_price_factor x the rule's max_price.

tv._help: Large TVs (Marktplaats > Audio, Tv en Foto > Televisies), newest page per center. Parsing in tv.py: inch, res (HD/FHD/4K/8K or null = unknown), panel (OLED/QLED/LED/LCD/PLASMA), smart, year. Damaged listings alert with a ⚠️ quote of the defect (global "damage": "warn"; "skip" drops them); parts/accessories and 'gezocht' listings never alert. Same keys as monitor rules plus not_panel [list] and smart (true). Same Utrecht price factor.
